title: b7z9.37.1.2(c-ii): wall-clock seam + root-sig expiry enforcement
description: Split from b7z9.37.1.2(c): the receiver-side expiry check (spec 8.10.1 receiver step 6: expiry > now) needs a unix-time source in lichen-node — none exists today (SystemTime only seeds scheduler-test RNGs; the RPL runtime is monotonic-ms). Design needed: where embedded nodes learn unix time (GNSS per 2h1i.1.2.2, NTP-over-CoAP, DIO-carried time) and the clockless-node behavior (L679/R-05-080 precedent: skip the expiry check when no clock, never reject on missing capability). The (c) core wiring lands first with expiry deferred (structural+signature+cross-check+RootSeqCache run unconditionally; expiry runs only when a clock seam lands).
